title: EnvDoctor repository build environment
description: Configuration contract for EnvDoctor's own build environment. The only environment variables this repository sets as real configuration are the Go cross-compilation knobs used by the CI crossbuild job (GOOS, GOARCH, CGO_ENABLED). Every variable is optional: a normal development build sets none of them, so this contract never fails on an arbitrary developer machine while still rejecting misspelled or out-of-range values when they do appear.

GOOS.description: Go cross-compilation target operating system, set by the CI crossbuild job.

GOARCH.description: Go cross-compilation target architecture, set by the CI crossbuild job.

CGO_ENABLED.description: Whether cgo is enabled for a cross-build. The CI crossbuild job disables it (0).
